Technical definitions only: mechanism, why each stage is missed, and how it can be recognized at a public level. No thresholds or protected logic are included.

1. [Stage 1 — Data Fragmentation](stage-1-data-fragmentation.html)
2. [Stage 2 — Symbolic Identity Fracturing (SIF)](stage-2-symbolic-identity-fracturing.html)
3. [Stage 3 — Symbolic Drift Cascade (SDC)](stage-3-symbolic-drift-cascade.html)
   - [The Vulnerability Window](vulnerability-window.html) sits between Stage 3 and Stage 4; it is not a numbered stage.
4. [Stage 4 — Role Obsolescence Cascade (ROC)](stage-4-role-obsolescence-cascade.html)
5. [Stage 5 — Complete Collapse](stage-5-complete-collapse.html)
